text:
ema: Quick sync — proposing a 'residency-projection' dark‑launch to reduce cross-region handshakes for active/active writes. idea is to let clients send a residency stamp header and have proxies shadow-route based on it, without enforcing yet. want to discuss rollout, metrics, and failure modes.

devin: sounds good. is this just a proxy header or do we tie into control plane tenancy metadata?

ema: proxy header only for now. control plane stays authoritative. header = X-Resident-Region: eu-west-1;stamp=v2. proxies will check stamp -> attempt local route, but if local rejects we'll still continue normal routing (shadow request recorded). no writes blocked in observe mode.

sasha: key ops questions: 1) what failure telemetry do we need to decide move to enforce? 2) how do we avoid cache poisoning if proxies start relying on stamps?

zane: for telemetry i'd track: shadowed_cross_region_rate, resident_write_latency_p50/p95, resident_write_reject_rate, kv-cache-hit-change, and per-tenant rollup. thresholds: if reject_rate <0.1% and p95 < baseline+20ms for 24h then ok to escalate.

luis: cache poisoning risk is real. suggestion: stamp-routing only used for routing decision when KV-ownership table explicitly marks tenant as prewarmed=true OR when stamp_safety_token matches server-side HMAC. otherwise proxy falls back to control-plane lookup.

ema: agree on HMAC check. simple header example: `X-Resident-Region: eu-west-1;stamp=v2;sig=sha256:...` psuedocode we plan to use in proxy:```if header && verify_sig(header.sig) && (prewarm||mode==enforce) then route_by_header else normal_route() record_shadow_metric()```

devin: rollout plan thoughts: 1) observe (shadow) at 100% traffic for 72h 2) gated canary: 5% tenants with prewarm flag 3) increase to 25% after 48h 4) enforce for those tenants after 7d 5) slowly expand. Add an 'escape hatch' that flips mode=observe globally.

sasha: operational playbook: when we see kv-cache-hit-change > 5% or resident_write_reject_rate spike, auto-pop an alert to #eng-oncall and pause canary (mode -> observe). we also need a dashboard: per-region heatmap and a per-tenant timeline for shadow mismatches.

zane: one more thing — cross-region cost accounting. even in observe mode we will be sending shadow requests to resident region, that doubles traffic during canary. need to budget and tag metrics with `shadow=true` so billing pipeline ignores for customer billing but infra team sees egress.

luis: what about privacy/consent? we must ensure the stamp does not transmit PII. stamp must be opaque token; control plane maps token->residency. docs and SDKs must enforce no tenant-level PII in headers.

ema: agreed. make token TTL short (1h) and audited. add KMS wrapper so stamps are HMAC'd by control plane.

devin: fallback policy when resident region is unhealthy: keep executing normal global fallback (best-latency route). we should expose a per-tenant config e.g. residency_projection.mode = observe|canary|enforce|disabled and residency_projection.fallthrough = regional|global.

sasha: can we test split-brain scenarios? e.g., two proxies both think tenant prewarmed but control-plane says otherwise. need a reconcile job that scans shadow mismatch rate and if > threshold, marks tenant for manual review.

zane: reconciliation approach: every 6h run that compares control-plane ownership vs proxy prewarm table; emit `residency_mismatch_tenants` and auto-rollback for tenants with mismatch_count>10 in last 30m.

ops-bot: deploy: canary proxies (residency-projection v0.1) deployed to eu-west-1 and us-west-2 at 1714801200 :rocket:

luis: docs checklist for SDKs: 1) header generation example w/ sig 2) token refresh sample 3) warning about not embedding PII 4) migration guide for tenants that want to opt-in immediately.

ema: next steps: i'll draft RFC addendum with: header spec, HMAC scheme, rollout plan, metrics + grafana dashboard ids, and oncall runbook snippets. devin/sasha/zane/luis — can you review PR by EOD tomorrow? :pray:

devin: will review.

sasha: adding small nit — include chaos test in staging that simulates 30s resident-region flaps. otherwise lgtm.

zane: i'll sketch the dashboards and alert rules.

luis: i'll write the SDK samples and token helper code.

ema: thanks team — syncing this into #architecture notes and RFC thread. we'll keep observe-phase metrics public. :white_check_mark:
